facts.business: Stanley Lifestyles Limited is a luxury furniture and home solutions company with a focus on retail experience, full-home solutions, and a national footprint.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure for purchase of new machinery and equipment by the Company and its material subsidiary, Stanley OEM Sofas Limited

guidance_or_targets.statement: As we enter FY2027 on the back of our highest-ever order book, our momentum will be supported by growing traction in full-home solutions and a competitive landscape increasingly shaped in the Company's favour.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text

facts.related_party_note: The Board of Directors has in principle approved the proposed amalgamation of Stanley OEM Sofas Limited, Stanley Retail Limited, Sana Lifestyles Limited, Staras Seating Private Limited, and Shrasta Decor Private Limited with Stanley Lifestyles Limited under the pooling of interest method per Ind AS 103.
